items.title: Stock Market LIVE: GIFT Nifty jumps 300 pts; Asia markets advance; Brent below $92
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Wednesday: The GIFT Nifty indicated a gap-up open for the Nifty50 index. Asian markets were trading higher in early deals

items.title: What next for Nifty after a gap-up open on Wed? Analysts decode strategy
items.description: Ponmudi of Enrich Money reckons that the Nifty is likely to maintain a positive near-term bias, while some consolidation may emerge following the sharp recent rally.

items.title: Stocks to watch: Kalyan Jewellers, MTNL, Dabur, IIFL Finance, MRF, NBCC
items.description: Stocks to watch: Kalyan Jewellers, MTNL, Dabur, HUL, IIFL Finance, MRF, NBCC, Balrampur Chini Mills, Tata Motors PV, DLF, Bajaj Finance, among others, will be in focus today.

items.title: Festive demand, export recovery drive auto sector growth, says MOFSL
items.description: The medium-term sector outlook remains favourable, supported by steady volume growth, product launches, improving exports and a gradual recovery in rural demand.

items.title: Hindalco, Airtel among 2 stock recommendations by Kotak's Shrikant Chouhan
items.description: Shrikant Chouhan remains constructive on Hindalco's outlook, supported by strong copper profitability, gradual recovery at Novelis, and continued progress on strategic growth initiatives.

items.title: PB Fintech: Retailers buy, FPIs turn wary in Q2; who got right end of deal?
items.description: According to analysts, FPIs' response was a reaction to the policy shock, even as retail investors focused on the business.

items.title: Bulls in action! Sensex zooms 1,400 pts intraday; oil, FII buying aid rally
items.description: Experts said that strong FII participation in the past few sessions and better-than-expected corporate earnings are supporting the market rally.

items.title: Rentomojo climbs 10% to 52-wk high; what's behind gains as Q2 PAT dips 63%?
items.description: Rentomojo, which made its Dalal Street debut in September this year, reported a 63 per cent Y-o-Y decline in consolidated net profit to ₹18.1 crore for the September quarter (Q2FY27)

items.title: BHEL shares up 3.5% on Power Grid order for Gujarat synchronous condensers
items.description: BHEL has received a Notification of Award from Power Grid Corporation of India, for setting up two synchronous condensers of +300/-200 MVAR capacity at Kalyanpur in Gujarat

items.title: Punjab National Bank share price soars 11% in two days; hits 52-week high
items.description: Share price of Punjab National Bank hit a 52-week high of ₹139, rallying 5% on the BSE in Wednesday's intraday deals amid heavy volume.

items.title: Gold faces inflation headwinds on hawkish Fed tilt; $4,150 stays key hurdle
items.description: Gold futures on the daily chart witnessed a rebound from the 138000 zone, but the recovery lacked strength as prices failed to sustain above the crucial 146000 resistance level.

items.title: Bank Nifty tops 61,000, nears all-time high; what do charts say?
items.description: The Bank Nifty has surged 12% thus far in November and quoted near its life-time high of 61,765 hit in February 2026.

items.title: Whirlpool gains 3% even as Q2 PAT sinks 40%; ICICI Sec maintains 'Reduce'
items.description: Whirlpool of India reported a 40% YoY decline in consolidated net profit to ₹25.08 crore in Q2FY27, impacted by inflation fueled by geopolitical instability, crude oil prices & rupee depreciation

items.title: Nifty Bank index rallies 4% in two days, nears record high; here's why
items.description: Bank of Baroda and Punjab National Bank were up 5% each, while Federal Bank, IDFC First Bank and AU Small Finance Bank gained 4% each in Wednesday's trading session.

items.title: Avanti Feeds shares stumble 6% as Q2 profit more than halves to ₹69 crore
items.description: Avanti Feeds posted a 55 per cent year-on-year (YoY) decline in the consolidated net profit (attributable to the owners of the company) to ₹68.95 crore.

items.title: MRF shares gain after Q2 results; Centrum bullish, sees margin recovery
items.description: MRF's revenue from operations rose by almost 18 per cent to ₹8,524 crore, while total expenses grew by more than 22 per cent

items.title: Railway stocks RVNL, RailTel gain up to 7%; experts see valuation comfort
items.description: Experts said that the gains in railway stocks reflect positive investor sentiment towards the sector after almost two-year of underperformance.

items.title: At new highs! Eternal, Groww, Adani Ports, Ather, 16 more NSE 500 stocks
items.description: Engineers India, Indian Hotels Company, Marico, Navin Fluorine International, Asahi India Glass and Phoenix Mills from the Nifty 500 index also hit new life-time highs on Wednesday.

items.title: Ashoka Buildcon shares jump 15% on ₹866 crore NHAI expressway contract
items.description: Ashoka Buildcon has received a Letter of Acceptance from the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) for the balance work on eight-lane, access-controlled stretch of the Vadodara-Mumbai Expressway

items.title: Kalyan Jewellers surges 10%, hits 52-week high post Q2 results
items.description: The average trading volume at the Kalyan Jewellers' counter jumped 10-fold with a combined 17.37 million shares changing hands on the NSE and BSE till 09:32 AM on Wednesday.

items.title: Cochin Shipyard tanks 8% post Q2 show; what's plaguing the defence stock?
items.description: Cochin Shipyard's consolidated net profit declined 49.9 per cent year-on-year (YoY) to ₹53.77 crore in Q2 FY27 from ₹107.53 crore in the year-ago period.

items.title: FPIs pump ₹56,771 cr into equities in 8 days; biggest inflow since Dec 2020
items.description: Analysts say the sudden change in FPI stance was triggered by the artificial intelligence (AI) sell-off in the US and other AI markets like South Korea, Taiwan and Japan.

items.title: IIFL Finance-Blackstone deal: Stock gains 4%; brokerages decode impact
items.description: US-based Blackstone, the world's largest alternative asset manager, will invest ₹5,000 crore (about $535 million) for a nearly 16 per cent stake in IIFL Finance

items.title: Jefferies bets on largecaps as FPIs return; RIL, HDFC among top plays
items.description: Jefferies believes that a potential AI-trade reversal, any equity tax relief, resilient domestic macro, reasonable large-cap valuations and light positioning could sustain these flows.

items.title: Strong asset growth, moderate valuations bode well for IIFL Finance stock
items.description: Blackstone-led capital infusion of ₹6,414 crore is expected to strengthen IIFL Finance's capital adequacy, ease funding constraints and support growth in its secured lending business

items.title: Nifty eyes record as largecaps lead charge on strong corporate earnings
items.description: Strong Q2 earnings, attractive valuations and easing crude oil prices bring Sensex and Nifty closer to their record highs

items.title: Equity MF inflows fall 14% in October as mid-, smallcap investments cool
items.description: Net equity inflows fall to ₹32,994 crore as midcap and smallcap investments moderate; SIP contributions dip marginally to ₹32,160 crore amid profit booking and market volatility

items.title: Benchmarks rise nearly 1%; auto, bank stocks lead gains amid FPI inflows
items.description: FPI inflows, profit booking steer market to second consecutive session of gains

items.title: Consistent growth, margin gains to drive upside for Jubilant FoodWorks
items.description: Jubilant FoodWorks' better-than-expected September quarter performance, improving like-for-like growth and strong Popeyes expansion have prompted brokerages to retain bullish ratings

items.title: Bajaj Finance launches ₹11,700 crore QIP at 5% discount to closing price
items.description: NBFC sets indicative issue price at ₹1,025 per share, above Sebi's floor price; proceeds will be used to repay borrowings and meet general corporate requirements

items.title: NRIs can complete investment KYC from abroad starting Dec 3: What changes?
